test_cases.title: Verify that a logged-in user can add a single product to the shopping cart
preconditions: User is logged into the application
User is on the product listing page
steps: Click the 'Add to Cart' button for a specific product
Navigate to the shopping cart page
expected_result: The specific product added is visible in the shopping cart

test_cases.title: Verify cart badge updates correctly when adding multiple products
preconditions: User is logged into the application
steps: Add a product to the cart
Add a second, different product to the cart
expected_result: The cart badge displays the total number of products (2) currently in the cart

test_cases.title: Verify ability to proceed to checkout from the cart
preconditions: User is logged into the application
A product has been added to the shopping cart
steps: Navigate to the shopping cart page
Click the button to proceed to checkout
expected_result: The user is successfully redirected to the checkout flow
